title: Heroku removing mLab MongoDB add-on.
body:
Heroku removing mLab MongoDB add-on.
Is there any other "free" options to use?

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4199669/87188964-0e88b000-c2f0-11ea-9cf6-ff3e951e9daf.png)

comments.body:
Heroku and nightscout are no issues with xdrip+. You can host it yourself on a raspberry pi, even in a docker container. 

I came across a free and friendly nightscout hoster at https://ns.10be.de/de/index.html. Consider supporting it with a donation.

if you follow the email instructions, you will be able to migrate to the new database. follow the link included in the email. Further instructions are available there, with several steps including changing a setting in heroku
You also can have more info about it on: https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/issues/5744
